opinion.headline: Batten down, ride out shipping storm

opinion.headline: Organise a fair organ transplant regime
opinion.hook: The National Organ and Tissue Transplant Organisation of India has unveiled a groundbreaking national portal designed to streamline organ allocation and establish a unified waiting list.
